```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Basic Example

The `groupby` transform was removed from plotly.js. Use `split` instead to
add one trace per group, and the figure's `colorway` to color the groups.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

cars <- cbind(make = rownames(mtcars), mtcars)

cars |>
  go_figure() |>
  update_layout(colorway = c("blue", "red", "black")) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~hp,
    y = ~qsec,
    text = ~ paste("Make: ", make,
                   "<br>hp: ", hp,
                   "<br>qsec: ", qsec,
                   "<br>Cyl: ", cyl),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    mode = "markers",
    split = ~cyl
  )
```

#### Reference

See `go_scatter()` for more information and options!
